character: A glacier ski area at the head of the Tux valley, a side valley of the Zillertal, reaching 3,250 m and known for a long season from autumn into spring. Once Austria's only year-round ski area, it closed in mid-August 2026 and reopens for 2026-27 on 2 October 2026.
learning: Reference note: there are blue runs on the glacier and ski schools in Hintertux, but altitude and weather make it better for confident skiers early in the season. Confirm beginner options.

season.notes: Autumn ski season opened Oct 2, 2026 (official, via search summary). The glacier is no longer open year-round (closed mid-August 2026). Winter Zillertal 3000 tariff runs Dec 4, 2026 – Apr 11, 2027; the glacier's own 2026-27 closing date is unclear (sources give May 7, 2027 or later).

prices.note: Winter tariff valid Dec 4, 2026 – Apr 11, 2027 on the glacier and the wider Zillertal 3000 area (Mayrhofen included). Includes EUR 2 chip-card deposit. Later-start tickets: from 11:00 EUR 74, from 11:45 EUR 61.50, from 14:00 EUR 41. Autumn glacier-only tickets are priced separately.

source.note: Search summary of the official rates page, winter 2026/27: 1-day pass from 08:00 adult EUR 82.00, youth (born 2008–2011) EUR 65.50, child (born 2012–2020) EUR 37.00; valid Dec 4, 2026 – Apr 11, 2027 and also in the Ski- & Gletscherwelt Zillertal 3000; prices include a EUR 2 chip-card deposit; children born after Jan 1, 2021 ski free with an adult.
